title: agropyron kirkii var. longisetum
intro: Agropyron kirkii var. longisetum, commonly known as 'Kirk's Wheat-grass', is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Kirk's Wheat-grass include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
